text:
Maya S.: quick microcopy pass for the Batching toggle tooltip on the Model Settings page. current tooltip feels vague. three options below — trying to pick one that balances clarity + brevity + accessibility.

Maya S.: Current (live):
`Enables batching to improve throughput.`

Maya S.: Variants:
`A — Explicit benefit:`
`Batch requests together to increase throughput and lower token cost. May add a small latency increase for single requests.`

`B — Short + product tone:`
`Group similar requests for cheaper, faster processing. Best for high-traffic apps.`

`C — Accessibility-first:`
`When enabled, the server groups requests into batches. This can reduce cost and increase throughput; single-request latency may vary.`

Omar B.: I like A for transparency. callout about latency is important.

Lucy P.: prefer C for screen readers since it starts with "When enabled" and reads as a full sentence. also suggest adding `aria-describedby` tying tooltip to the toggle.

Ethan W.: can we add a tiny link: "How batching works" to the tooltip? engineers can point to docs for details.

DesignBot: suggestion: use C copy in UI, but show A phrasing on hover for mouse users and include the docs link. aria-label for toggle: `Enable request batching` and `aria-describedby` points to tooltip id.

Maya S.: good plan. I'll update the tooltip copy to C, include docs link, and add aria attributes in the PR. thanks! :sparkles:
